---
title: "embedpdf names with no file name in the path"
resources:
  - "files/get"
---

Both embeds show a copy of `sample.pdf` with PDF.js. The checks in `tests/`
read the name that the viewer gives each one for screen readers.

## A query-style address

The address is `files/get?file=sample.pdf`. The file `files/get` is a copy of
`sample.pdf`, and the server ignores the query. The viewer takes the name from
the query value, so the embed is named "PDF: sample.pdf".

{{< pdf "files/get?file=sample.pdf" renderer=pdfjs >}}

## An inlined PDF with no download link

This embed is written by hand, not by the shortcode. Its `data-src` holds
`sample.pdf` as a `data:` address, and it has no download link that names the
file. The embed is named "PDF".

{{< include files/inlined-sample.md >}}
